clinical_review: DRAFT — written by the engineering team as a starting point. Must be reviewed and approved by the Clinical Lead before use with real clients.
name: Person-centred
description: Inspired by the core conditions and the client's own frame of reference. Our own wording.

scale.meaning: 1 = not present in this session, 3 = partly present, 5 = strongly and skilfully present

dimensions.label: Empathic understanding
dimensions.description: Sensing and communicating the client's inner world as if it were one's own, without losing the 'as if'.

anchors.1: Responses come from the therapist's frame, not the client's.
anchors.3: Accurate understanding of what was said.
anchors.5: Deep, accurate understanding of felt meaning, communicated tentatively.

dimensions.label: Unconditional positive regard
dimensions.description: Warm acceptance of the client as a person, without judgement or conditions.

anchors.1: Judgement, approval or disapproval is evident.
anchors.3: Generally accepting, with occasional evaluative moments.
anchors.5: Consistent warmth and acceptance, including of difficult feelings.

dimensions.label: Congruence
dimensions.description: Being genuine and present; the therapist's responses feel real rather than technique-driven.

anchors.5: Genuinely present; appropriate transparency when it serves the client.

dimensions.label: Following the client's direction
dimensions.description: Letting the client lead; trusting their direction and pace.

anchors.5: The client clearly leads; the therapist follows closely.

dimensions.label: Non-directiveness
dimensions.description: Avoiding advice, interpretation or agenda-setting that takes over the client's process.

dimensions.label: Presence and space
dimensions.description: Unhurried attention; room for silence and feeling.

anchors.5: Calm, attentive presence; silences are allowed to do their work.
